verses.gurmukhi: ੧੨ : ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਵਿਚ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: 12 : gur sikh karam dharam to(n) u'chaa sukhafal vich hai|

en.bdb: Gursikh is above ritualism and lives in the pleasure-fruit

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਹਠ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕਰਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: jap tap sa(n)jam saadhanaa haTh nigreh karane|

en.bdb: Actions such as recitations, austerities, continence, devotion, perseverence, control over senses, etc. are performed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਘਣੇ ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਧਰਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: varat nem teerath ghane adhiaatam dharane|

en.bdb: For spirituality, fasts, observances, pilgrimages are undertaken.
One gets inclined towards temples for the worship of gods and goddesses.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਵੇਦ ਉਚਰਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: hom jag bahu dhaan kar mukh vedh ucharane|

en.bdb: Besides burnt offerings and charities of many kinds, Vedic hymns are chanted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: karam dharam bhai bharam vich bahu ja(n)man marane|

en.bdb: Getting stuck in such religious, ritualistic illusions, fear and doubt only leads to transmigration.
